event.description: Use RMSNorm only at block 0 pre-attention
event.proposal: Family: normalization. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 4 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0018, which removed the final LayerNorm bias at 3,360 parameters/99.07%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0112, whose block-0 pre-FF-only RMSNorm scored 0.00% at 1,658 parameters. Hypothesis: mean centering may be essential for nonlinear feature construction but redundant before the first attention routing operation. Replace only block 0 pre-attention LayerNorm with per-coordinate RMSNorm, migrate its 16 scales, retain all other LayerNorm sites, and remove its 14 learned bias values for 1,658 parameters. This is more informative than block 1 first because block 0 directly processes token-plus-position inputs and cleanly isolates whether initial attention needs centering, complementing attempt-0112 at identical count.
